projects.name: Lofi Player
projects.fullDescription: Lofi Hip-hop Player is a minimalist music player designed to enhance focus and productivity during studying, coding, or creative work. It provides a calm, distraction-free listening experience centered around smooth lofi hip-hop tracks that help users stay relaxed while maintaining concentration.

projects.name: Keylock
projects.description: Embedded C++ code for a door lock
projects.fullDescription: Keylock is an embedded door-lock system developed in Embedded C/C++ on the Tiva-C (TM4C123GH6PM) microcontroller. The project implements a secure, real-time access control mechanism using low-level register manipulation and layered embedded design principles.
